summary: This test verifies that when the helpers function is called with an invalid input file path, it properly catches the error and displays an appropriate error message to the user.

explanations.2: This loads the helpers.sh script into the current shell session so we can test the functions it contains.
explanations.3: This creates an array called arrArguments that holds the command-line arguments we want to pass to our function, simulating what a user would type.
explanations.4: The run command executes the helpers function with our test arguments and captures its output so we can check what it produced.
explanations.5: This asserts that the captured output matches a pattern — it should be an error message that mentions the input file and says it doesn't exist, where .* is a wildcard matching any characters.
